name: a1-bmg-p1
headline: Human Written
windows: In my experience, beach morning glory is the ultimate sledgehammer for stopping a psychedelic trip cold and fast. By beach morning glory I mean Ipomoea pes-caprae, not morning glories in general, since none of the many relatives and cousins I tried worked the same way.
It isn't sold anywhere else, as far as I know.

name: a1-bmg-p2
headline: Human Written
windows: A whole leaf can easily end the trip and, in my experience, may keep you from tripping for days afterward. A tiny nibble can sometimes smooth psychedelic nausea and even improve the trip without ending it. But it takes only a little more than a nibble to end the trip, so I use it for nausea only when the person is okay with their trip possibly ending.

name: a1-bmg-p2p3
headline: Human Written
windows: A whole leaf can easily end the trip and, in my experience, may keep you from tripping for days afterward. A tiny nibble can sometimes smooth psychedelic nausea and even improve the trip without ending it.
But it takes only a little more than a nibble to end the trip, so I use it for nausea only when the person is okay with their trip possibly ending.
The leaf is strong enough that even picking one can affect me if the juice from the broken part touches sensitive skin, especially under my fingernails, so I keep my skin away from the broken end.

name: a1-bmg-p4p5
headline: Human Written
windows:
I've seen it work on someone else too: I once gave beach morning glory to a woman who was nauseous and miserable on a psychedelic, and within a couple of minutes she was very happy. I was rushing to help her and may have given more than I would now.
The trips I've seen it stop were psychedelic ones, and I don't yet have data showing that pes-caprae aborts MDMA, so for MDMA, go to MDMA: Magnesium Alarm instead.
